evaluation_boundary: Lock 256 unique sequences ranked by Design reward before all post-hoc scoring.
compliance_measurement: Report GC 0.30-0.70 and maximum homopolymer 6 on every locked set; never filter DNA_TTO candidates by these metrics.
selection_history: The no-filter model definition was chosen after inspecting the preceding component results; this is a follow-up component study, not an untouched confirmation set.
budget_boundary: 15,360 counts gradient-step sequence evaluations only. Initial/final scoring, pool scoring, and other model calls are additional.
repeated_start_policy: Preserve Table 3 repeated teacher-forced starts without new random perturbations; three seeds are the statistical units.
resource_policy: Start only on GPU with no reported compute processes and low memory/use on consecutive observations; do not stop other users' jobs.
